note: Flexible payloads, result references, dead-letter/error copies and River job args/errors/metadata conservatively carry PII. All app columns and the registered queue.river_job table are catalog-checked. Other pinned upstream queue tables are vendor operational infrastructure outside app scope; no phantom export-staging app table is declared before the data-rights migration lands.

structures.AuditPayload: Audit object including arbitrary module-provided data and possible contact copies.
structures.IdempotencyResponseBody: Durable JSON replay response including quote data; originating operation owns its PII semantics.
structures.OutboxPayload: Event envelope: order.*, quote.*, notification.dispatch and future producer-specific objects; includes recipient/contact copies.
structures.RiverJobArgs: Heterogeneous River job JSON object: signed tenant job args may hold derived business/contact payload. Job kind controls verified subject semantics.
structures.RiverJobErrors: Array of River JSON error entries including worker failure message, timestamp and trace; error strings can duplicate personal payload.
structures.RiverJobMetadata: Heterogeneous JSON metadata object from producers/River hooks; conservatively may carry personal copies.
structures.RiverUniqueDigest: Opaque River unique-job bytea digest; no plaintext job payload or customer contact.
structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte cryptographic digest for integrity/request identity/capability verification; never raw token, body or contact data.

subject.identity_path: actor_kind=customer: actor_id -> customers.id; user: actor_id -> users.id
subject.null_subject_policy: API key/service actors and referenced bodies require originating-operation ownership; do not infer subjects from response contents.
Audit actor/resource identifiers are polymorphic; payload subjects require originating module identity paths, not email matching.

subject.identity_path: order.* payload.order_id -> orders.customer_id; quote.approved payload.quote_id -> quotes.accepted_by; notification.dispatch payload.notification_id -> notification_deliveries.reference_id
subject.null_subject_policy: Other producers, quote.sent and guest events use producer-specific ownership; unverified payload email is not identity proof.
Opaque provider payload reference; originating provider/event adapter must resolve verified ownership, never infer it from provider contact fields.

Heterogeneous vendor job table; tenant_id inside signed args is not a SQL FK. Only the trusted job kind/producer contract may resolve registered-customer ownership; never infer identity from email in args/errors/metadata.
